title: Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description: HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com , General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024). HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations. HackerOne Values HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability. Senior Manager, AI Engineering Remote Location: Seattle, WA or Austin, TX Position Summary At HackerOne, AI is central to how we help organizations continuously identify and reduce cyber risk. As a Senior Manager, AI Engineering , you will lead multiple AI engineering teams building and scaling AI-powered capabilities across our offensive security platform. Your work will directly impact how customers discover vulnerabilities earlier, remediate faster, and trust AI-driven security outcomes at scale. In this role, you will empower Engineering Managers and senior engineers, shape how applied AI is delivered responsibly, and ensure teams consistently translate AI innovation into reliable, customer-impacting products. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Security Research to scale AI systems that combine automation with human expertise in meaningful ways. At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Seattle or Austin . We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work. NOTE: Must be able and willing to come to the office once per week (typically Thursdays). What You Will Do Success in the Senior Manager, AI Engineering role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne. Multiply Your Impact by leading, mentoring, and developing Engineering Managers and senior engineers, building scalable systems and practices that allow teams to deliver AI-powered solutions consistently and independently Own the Outcome for execution across multiple AI engineering teams, ensuring delivery commitments are met, dependencies are actively managed, and teams are accountable for customer-visible impact Drive an AI First approach to engineering by embedding AI-powered workflows, agentic systems, and responsible AI practices into how teams design, build, and operate products Practice Change Agility by guiding teams through evolving AI technologies, shifting priorities, and emerging security threats while maintaining clarity, momentum, and team health Apply First Principles Problem Solving to complex AI and product challenges, breaking problems down to fundamentals and designing durable, scalable solutions rather than short-term workarounds Leverage Data-Driven Decision Making to assess system performance, model quality, delivery outcomes, and operational health, using evidence to inform priorities and improvements Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, Data, Security Research, and other Engineering leaders to align AI engineering efforts with company strategy and customer needs Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of experience managing product engineering teams, including teams delivering AI-powered or data-intensive systems Demonstrated experience leading teams with complex dependencies across engineering, product, and non-technical partners Experience developing and mentoring Engineering Managers Strong technical foundation in modern software systems that support AI-enabled products Preferred Qualifications Experience building or scaling applied AI systems in production environments Familiarity with human-in-the-loop, agentic, or automation-driven workflows Experience with technologies in HackerOne’s core stack, including PostgreSQL, Rails, GraphQL, Apollo, and React Compensation Bands Base salary: $240,000 to $280,000 Offers equity (stock options) #LI-MH1 Job Benefits: Health (medical, vision, title: Lead AI Engineer, Agentic Systems - Capco AI Lab
description: We're looking for a Lead AI Engineer to join Capco's AI Frontier Lab, based in Paris. The Lab builds agentic AI solutions for clients in financial services and energy, and advises them on AI architecture and governance. The engineering team is already in place. What's missing is a senior technical lead who owns the architecture, reviews and shapes the team's work, still writes code, and can represent those technical decisions directly to the client.   What you'll do Lead the engineering (~40%) Own the architecture of our agentic solutions end to end: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory and state, retrieval, evaluation, observability, plus the cost and latency budgets that decide whether a system survives contact with production. Guide our engineers through design reviews, pairing and code review, raising the bar rather than quietly doing the work for them. Set the standards: reference architectures, agentic patterns, guardrails, testing and eval strategy, CI/CD for non-deterministic systems, deployment topology. Make the build/buy/adapt calls on frameworks, models and platforms, and be able to defend them a year later. Stay hands-on (~30%) Prototype fast, and build the hard parts yourself: the tricky orchestration, the eval harness, the integration nobody else wants to touch. Take promising prototypes to production grade, covering reliability, monitoring, versioning, rollback and human-in-the-loop where it matters. Work with clients (~30%) Act as our senior technical voice in solution discussions, workshops and pitches, translating between business outcomes and system design in both directions. Advise on AI architecture, platform strategy, model and vendor strategy, and governance as they actually apply to a client's operating model. Produce content that carries weight: reference architectures, points of view, whitepapers, and talks at client forums and conferences. What we're looking for Essential 8+ years in software or data engineering, including genuine enterprise architecture experience. You've designed systems that had to survive security review, integration hell and real production traffic. You still write code, and you'd be comfortable opening a pull request in your second week. Strong Python or equivalent. Demonstrable agentic AI experience: agentic loops and orchestration, tool use and function calling, multi-agent patterns, MCP or comparable integration approaches, and, critically, how you evaluate AI solutions. Depth on at least one major cloud platform, with the surrounding discipline: containers, IaC, observability, security. Presence with clients. You can hold a room of senior stakeholders, disagree respectfully, and explain a trade-off without retreating into jargon. A real interest in making other engineers better. This role is measured partly by what the team can do without you. Valuable additions Domain experience in financial services or energy, and an understanding of what regulation means for system design in those sectors. A consulting or client-facing delivery background. Open-source contributions, publications, or a speaking track record. Hands-on AI governance, risk or assurance work. French alongside fluent English. What we offer A Lab with a real mandate and real clients. The work ships, and you'll see it running. Influence over technical direction from day one, not after a two-year wait. The rare combination of deep engineering and senior advisory work, without having to give up either.       Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Operational Excellence & Procedures Lead
description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Role Description The Operational Excellence & Procedures Lead is responsible for driving continuous improvement across Operations, ensuring that operational processes, procedures, knowledge management and supporting technologies evolve in line with the Bank's growth strategy. Sitting within the Operations – Financial Crime and Customer Experience function, this role acts as the bridge between Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and Change, ensuring operational processes remain efficient, scalable, customer focused and well governed. The role goes beyond traditional business procedure management by including the adoption of AI-enabled solutions across Operations. The successful candidate will identify opportunities to automate manual activities, improve colleague productivity, enhance knowledge management and embed intelligent workflows that support better customer and business outcomes, while ensuring that the process for keeping procedures updated remains efficient and scalable. This is a key role in shaping the future operating model of Operations, driving operational excellence, process optimisation and AI adoption to ensure Allica remains at the forefront of modern banking operations, with well mitigated operational risk. Operational Excellence Own and continuously evolve the way Operations works. Lead process/procedure reviews across all operational functions, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate activities. Facilitate workshops to map, review and optimise end-to-end customer journeys and operational processes. Partner with operational teams to identify pain points, risks and inefficiencies, delivering practical and measurable solutions. Ensure operational processes remain scalable and aligned to the Bank's strategic objectives. Track and report on process performance metrics and continuous improvement outcomes. Support the successful operational embedding of new products, services, regulatory changes and technology enhancements. Process & Procedure Governance Maintain oversight of operational process documentation and procedure standards across Operations. Support Procedure Owners in maintaining accurate, compliant and version-controlled procedures. Own reviews and updates for central operations procedures, ensuring any updates are signed off by key business stakeholders and communicated to end users. Routinely review and update FAQs, seeking appropriate stakeholder signoff and publishing on the website. Ensure operational procedures remain aligned to Bank Policies, Risk Frameworks and regulatory requirements. Conduct impact assessments for product, technology and regulatory changes to identify documentation updates and operational implications. Attend Product, Change and Governance forums to ensure operational readiness considerations are captured. Facilitate procedure review activities and monitor closure of agreed actions. Promote best practice standards for process mapping, documentation and operational governance. AI Enablement & Innovation Lead the adoption of AI capabilities across Procedures and Training to improve productivity, quality, colleague experience and customer outcomes. Design, develop and continuously improve AI-enabled workflows using approved technologies, including Microsoft Copilot and other emerging AI tools. Measure, track and report on tangible benefits realised through AI adoption and automation initiatives. Champion a culture of innovation and continuous improvement across operational teams. Change Delivery & Business Readiness Support the successful delivery of operational change initiatives within the Operations department. Lead requirements gathering and discovery workshops with business stakeholders. Coordinate operational readiness assessments and implementation planning. Develop robust procedures and supporting materials to support change adoption. Maintain and continuously develop Management Information (MI) reporting across all areas of Operations, ensuring accurate, timely and meaningful reporting to support performance management, operational oversight and informed decision-making. Personal Attributes & Experience Significant experience within Operational Excellence, Business Process Improvement, Procedure Management and Stakeholder Management. Strong process mapping and end-to-end process design capability. 2+ years of line management experience. Excellent understanding of operational governance, risk management and control environments. Experience identifying and implementing operational efficiencies through automation or digital solutions. Strong understanding of applicable AI technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar platforms. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills. Strong workshop facilitation and business engagement experience. Exceptional written communication, documentation and presentation skills. Strong analytical capability with experience using data to support decision making. Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Desirable Experience designing AI prompts, knowledge assistants or AI-enabled workflows. Understanding of Operational Resilience, Consumer Duty and FCA regulatory requirements. Experience working within a fast-growing bank, fintech or regulated financial services environment. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles.
